key_points: Antitrust lawsuit alleging AI pricing system violates antitrust laws represents a significant legal risk for MCD
Multiple analyst firms (Morgan Stanley, Melius Research, Wells Fargo) have cut price targets, indicating loss of institutional confidence
Recent share sales and new ownership interest (e.g., Park National Corp acquisition attempt) suggest potential supply/demand pressures
Stock trading near a 52-week low creates strong downward technical momentum
While some reports note solid quarterly beat fundamentals, the dominant narrative is negative due to legal and valuation concerns
